summary: Cycle 2 holds. Evidence is bound: specSha256 in run-identity.json equals the sha256 of the spec file at 315c4330, dist CSS hashes pinned, 20 assertion records from the single final run; the sourceSha points at the pre-evidence-commit SHA of the same change, which is inherent to committing your own evidence.
